|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Tracked Fleet]] (version 2 of 3). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 25 release sheet (PDF created 10 August 2025), cut unchanged from page 3. The current text is [[Tracked Fleet (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Playtest''' ([[Tracked Fleet (Playtest)]]): Playtest image: PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-tf-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7821822/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/trackedfleet.gif trackedfleet.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7821822 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. Prints “relocate it to another system within 3 parsecs”. Text: “Deploy on D'Qar system (only at start of game). Tied To The End Of A String: You may not deploy starships here. Supremacy moves to here for free. There Will Be No Surrender: Three times per game, at start of opponent's move phase, opponent may stack a card from hand face down on this card to relocate it to another system within 3 parsecs. Fire At Will!: At the start of your turn, if you control this system, Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' (placed out of play).”
* '''Original''' ([[Tracked Fleet]]): PC card image of 8 August 2025<ref name="ht-tf-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d996b0/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/trackedfleet.gif trackedfleet.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9d996b0 9d996b0] (8 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: “relocate it to another system” becomes “relocate it to an [Episode VII] system”. The same text is printed on the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF built 10 August 2025, page 3). Text: “Deploy on D'Qar system (only at start of game). Tied To The End Of A String: You may not deploy starships here. Supremacy moves to here for free. There Will Be No Surrender: Three times per game, at start of opponent's move phase, opponent may stack a card from hand face down on this card to relocate it to an [Episode VII] system within 3 parsecs. Fire At Will!: At the start of your turn, if you control this system, Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' (placed out of play).”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 10 August 2025: “Deploy on D'Qar system (only at start of game). Tied To The End Of A String: You may not deploy starships here. Supremacy moves to here for free. There Will Be No Surrender: Three times per game, at start of opponent's move phase, opponent may stack a card from hand face down on this card to relocate it to an [Episode VII] system within 3 parsecs. Fire At Will!: At the start of your turn, if you control this system, Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' (placed out of play).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Tracked Fleet]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Tracked Fleet]] (published 8 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Tracked Fleet”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Tracked Fleet (Errata 2)]]): PC card image of 11 May 2026<ref name="ht-tf-2">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/bdead15/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/trackedfleet.gif trackedfleet.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/bdead15 bdead15] (11 May 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: PC May 2026 errata (marked “E1”): “(or from top of Lost Pile)” added after “stack a card from hand” in There Will Be No Surrender. Text: “Deploy on D'Qar system (only at start of game). Tied To The End Of A String: You may not deploy starships here. Supremacy moves to here for free. There Will Be No Surrender: Three times per game, at start of opponent's move phase, opponent may stack a card from hand (or from top of Lost Pile) face down on this card to relocate it to an [Episode VII] system within 3 parsecs. Fire At Will!: At the start of your turn, if you control this system, Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' (placed out of play).”
